title: ProtAgent: Post-Training Compact Protein Tool Agents with Interaction-Level Credit Assignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33746v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein annotation agents must choose suitable bioinformatics tools, interpret their outputs, and use the resulting evidence in the final answer. Most existing systems rely on frontier-scale models. We ask whether a compact model can instead learn this behavior through post-training with real tool interaction. We present ProtAgent, a two-stage pipeline that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the tool interface and standard on-policy REINFORCE to improve the interaction policy. Intermediate tool calls receive action rewards, and the final response receives a terminal answer reward. Step-level returns assign these rewards to the responses that produced them and to preceding actions. The episode-level baseline instead assigns one episode return to every action. On a fixed closed-loop protocol with real bioinformatics tools, ProtAgent-8B achieves 61.00% success under the annotation-coverage metric, compared with 41.60% for DeepSeek

translated_title: ProtAgent：通过交互级信用分配对紧凑型蛋白质工具智能体进行后训练
translated_abstract: 蛋白质注释智能体需要选择合适的生物信息学工具、解释其输出，并将所得证据用于最终答案。大多数现有系统依赖于前沿规模的大模型。我们探讨一个紧凑型模型是否能通过与真实工具交互的后训练来学习这种行为。我们提出ProtAgent，一个两阶段流程：使用监督微调（SFT）学习工具接口，并使用标准的同策略REINFORCE改进交互策略。中间的工具调用会获得动作奖励，最终响应会获得终止答案奖励。步级回报将这些奖励分配给产生它们的响应以及先前的动作；而回合级基线则将整个回合的回报分配给每一个动作。在使用真实生物信息学工具的固定闭环协议下，ProtAgent-8B在注释覆盖率指标下达到61.00%的成功率，相比之下DeepSeek为41.60%。
tldr: ProtAgent提出了一种两阶段后训练方法，结合SFT学习工具接口、REINFORCE改进交互策略以及交互级信用分配机制，使仅8B参数的紧凑模型在使用真实生物信息学工具的蛋白质注释任务上达到61%的成功率，显著超越更大规模的模型。
en_tdlr: ProtAgent introduces a two-stage post-training pipeline combining SFT for tool interfaces and on-policy REINFORCE with interaction-level credit assignment, enabling a compact 8B model to achieve 61% success on protein annotation tasks with real bioinformatics tools, significantly outperforming larger frontier models.
